AcidSpray.Label: acid spray
AcidSpray.Description: Carriers grow glands in the neck that generate and store a sticky acid substance, along with acid-tolerant tissues in the mouth. They can spew this acid over an area, where it will stick to enemies and burn them.

Ageless.Label: ageless
Ageless.Description: Carriers of this gene have archites in the bloodstream which continuously reverse the process of aging. Starting at the age of 13, carriers begin to biologically age slower. By 18, the aging process stops completely.

Aggression_Aggressive.Label: aggressive
Aggression_Aggressive.Description: Carriers of this gene are quick to anger. They are twice as likely to start social fights. When they have mental breaks, they are twice as likely to choose an aggressive kind of break.

Aggression_DeadCalm.Label: dead calm
Aggression_DeadCalm.Description: Carriers of this gene feel calm in every situation and have a very placid demeanor. They will never start social fights or have aggressive mental breaks.

Aggression_HyperAggressive.Label: hyper-aggressive
Aggression_HyperAggressive.Description: Carriers of this gene are hormonally high-strung and very aggressive. They are three times as likely to start social fights. Any mental break they have will be of an aggressive type.

AnimalWarcall.Label: animal warcall
AnimalWarcall.Description: Carriers of this gene can perform an animal warcall, using a powerful bellow and psychic connection to call an animal to fight for them.

ArchiteMetabolism.Label: archite metabolism
ArchiteMetabolism.Description: Carriers of this gene have special archites in their cells that facilitate and optimize metabolism. This improves overall genetic and metabolic quality.

Beard_Always.Label: unisex beards
Beard_Always.Description: Carriers of this gene always have thick facial hair, even women.

Beard_BushyOnly.Label: only bushy beards
Beard_BushyOnly.Description: Male carriers of this gene experience rapid beard growth and are uncomfortable cutting their beards.

Beard_NoBeardOnly.Label: beardless
Beard_NoBeardOnly.Description: Carriers of this gene grow no facial hair.

Beauty_Beautiful.Label: very attractive
Beauty_Beautiful.Description: Carriers of this gene have remarkably precise and symmetrical faces. Their features are distinctive and strong without being exaggerated, and their skin is nearly perfect. They are generally seen as beautiful.

Beauty_Pretty.Label: attractive
Beauty_Pretty.Description: Carriers of this gene have unusually symmetrical, balanced facial features and extra-clear skin which gives them a pleasing appearance.

Beauty_Ugly.Label: unattractive
Beauty_Ugly.Description: Carriers of this gene have exaggerated facial features and poor skin that are generally considered ugly.

Beauty_VeryUgly.Label: very unattractive
Beauty_VeryUgly.Description: Carriers of this gene have misshapen, asymmetrical facial structures and blotchy skin. They're hard to look at.

Bloodfeeder.Label: bloodfeeder
Bloodfeeder.Description: Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from fresh warm blood. They can bite an unresisting person, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly.

Body_Fat.Label: fat body
Body_Fat.Description: Carriers can have fat bodies. A person can have more than one body type gene; one body type will be chosen among those that are allowed.

Body_Hulk.Label: hulk body
Body_Hulk.Description: Carriers can have large bodies. A person can have more than one body type gene; one body type will be chosen among those that are allowed.

Body_Standard.Label: standard body
Body_Standard.Description: Carriers can have average-shaped bodies. A person can have more than one body type gene; one body type will be chosen among those that are allowed.

Body_Thin.Label: thin body
Body_Thin.Description: Carriers can have thin bodies. A person can have more than one body type gene; one body type will be chosen among those that are allowed.

Brow_Heavy.Label: heavy brow
Brow_Heavy.Description: Carriers of this gene have a prominent brow.

CaveDweller.Label: indoor dweller
CaveDweller.Description: Carriers of this gene have no need for the outdoors and will never feel cooped up no matter how long they stay inside.

ChemicalDependency_Alcohol.Label: alcohol dependency
ChemicalDependency_Alcohol.Description: Carriers of this gene need to ingest alcohol on a regular basis to survive. After {DEFICIENCYDURATION} without alcohol, carriers will suffer from alcohol deficiency. After {COMADURATION}, they will fall into a coma. After {DEATHDURATION}, they will die.

Coagulate.Label: coagulate
Coagulate.Description: Carriers of this gene have special glands on their hands and wrists, as well as a unique salivary compound that they can use to rapidly tend wounds.

DarkVision.Label: dark vision
DarkVision.Description: Carriers of this gene see well in low light and are unaffected by mood penalties related to darkness. They have a reflective layer behind the retina that amplifies their ability to see in the dark.

Deathless.Label: deathless
Deathless.Description: Carriers of this gene have archites in the blood which will sustain their life processes no matter what. As long as the brain remains intact, a carrier of this gene will never die.

Deathrest.Label: deathrest
Deathrest.Description:
Carriers of this gene must periodically regenerate themselves in a special coma called deathrest. Deathrest takes days, but can confer substantial bonuses. Deathrest can be accelerated and its effects enhanced by the use of a variety of special buildings and technologies.

Those who put off deathresting will suffer from deathrest exhaustion.

Delicate.Label: delicate
Delicate.Description: Carriers of this gene take greater injuries than others from the same damage. They have thin, brittle bones and less binding molecules in joints and flesh.

DiseaseFree.Label: non-senescent
DiseaseFree.Description: Carriers of this gene do not go through senescence in the normal way. They never get chronic age-related diseases like cancer, bad back, cataracts, or dementia.

Ears_Cat.Label: cat ears
Ears_Cat.Description: Carriers of this gene have cat-like ears.

Ears_Floppy.Label: floppy ears
Ears_Floppy.Description: Carriers of this gene grow long, floppy hound-like ears.

Ears_Human.Label: human ears
Ears_Human.Description: Carriers of this gene have regular human ears.

Ears_Pig.Label: pig ears
Ears_Pig.Description: Carriers of this gene will grow pointed pig-like ears.

Ears_Pointed.Label: pointed ears
Ears_Pointed.Description: Carriers of this gene have pointed ears.

ElongatedFingers.Label: elongated fingers
ElongatedFingers.Description: Long, delicate fingers improve the carrier's manipulation capacity. This aids with many tasks, especially crafting and construction.

Eyes_Gray.Label: gray eyes
Eyes_Gray.Description: Carriers of this gene have pale white-gray eyes.

Eyes_Red.Label: red eyes
Eyes_Red.Description: Carriers of this gene have deeply red-pigmented eyes.

FacialRidges.Label: facial ridges
FacialRidges.Description: Carriers of this gene grow raised ridges of skin on their face.

Fertile.Label: fertile
Fertile.Description: Carriers of this gene have a higher chance of becoming pregnant or impregnating others.

FireResistant.Label: fire resistant
FireResistant.Description: Carriers of this gene have special fast-acting sweat glands and heat-resistant skin. They only take 25% of the normal damage from fire. The chance of them catching on fire is also drastically reduced.

FireSpew.Label: fire spew
FireSpew.Description: Carriers are able to spew flammable bile generated by a special organ in their neck. The bile sticks to anything in a small area and can ignite people, objects, and the ground.

FireTerror.Label: pyrophobia
FireTerror.Description: Carriers of this gene have an intense fear of fire. When fires are close, there is a chance they will have a mental breakdown at any moment.

FireWeakness.Label: tinderskin
FireWeakness.Description: Carriers have dry, thin skin which burns easily from fire, and their immune systems react very poorly to this kind of threat. Damage from fire is multiplied by 4.

FoamSpray.Label: foam spray
FoamSpray.Description: Carriers grow glands in the neck that generate and store a fire-retardant foam. They can spew this foam over an area to extinguish fires.

Furskin.Label: furskin
Furskin.Description: Carriers of this gene grow thick fur all over their body, which protects them from cold temperatures.

Hair_BaldOnly.Description: Carriers of this gene grow no hair on the head.

Hemogenic.Label: hemogenic
Hemogenic.Description:
Carriers of this gene have a reserve of biological strength powered by a resource called hemogen. The resource can be gained and spent in various ways, all of which are unlocked by other genes.

Carriers lose 2 hemogen per day from biological entropy.

Immunity_Strong.Label: strong immunity
Immunity_Strong.Description: Carriers of this gene gain immunity to diseases faster than normal.

Immunity_SuperStrong.Label: super immunity
Immunity_SuperStrong.Description: Carriers of this gene gain immunity to diseases considerably faster than normal.

Immunity_Weak.Label: weak immunity
Immunity_Weak.Description: Carriers of this gene gain immunity to diseases more slowly than normal. They may die from infections that others would survive.

Inbred.Label: inbred
Inbred.Description: This genetic condition affects a person's fertility, immunity, and mental capacity.

Instability_Major.Label: major cell instability
Instability_Major.Description: Carriers of this gene need much less metabolic energy to stay alive, at the cost of greatly-reduced stability in their cell-replication machinery.

Instability_Mild.Label: mild cell instability
Instability_Mild.Description: Carriers of this gene need less metabolic energy to stay alive, at the cost of reduced stability in their cell-replication machinery.

Jaw_Baseline.Label: human jaw
Jaw_Baseline.Description: Carriers of this gene have regularly-shaped jaws.

Jaw_Heavy.Label: heavy jaw
Jaw_Heavy.Description: Carriers of this gene have large jaws.

KillThirst.Label: kill thirst
KillThirst.Description: Carriers of this gene lust for the feeling of ending another's life. They will become irritated if they go for too long without killing someone in close combat.

KindInstinct.Label: kind instinct
KindInstinct.Description: Carriers of this gene are high in trait agreeableness and are very conscientious. They rarely insult others and will sometimes offer kind words to brighten the moods of those around them. They also never judge people by their appearance.

Learning_Fast.Label: quick study
Learning_Fast.Description: Carriers of this gene have excellent memories and grasp new ideas quickly. They learn faster than others.

Learning_Slow.Label: slow study
Learning_Slow.Description: Carriers of this gene have deficient long-term memories and don't understand new ideas quickly. They are slow at learning new skills and knowledge.

Libido_High.Label: high libido
Libido_High.Description: Carriers of this gene are more likely to engage in lovin' with their partner.

Libido_Low.Label: low libido
Libido_Low.Description: Carriers of this gene are less likely to engage in lovin' with their partner.

LongjumpLegs.Label: longjump legs
LongjumpLegs.Description: Carriers have special hemogen-powered muscle fibers in their legs which allow them to jump great distances.

LowSleep.Label: low sleep
LowSleep.Description: Carriers of this gene get tired less quickly than others.

MaleWolfein_NoMoonPhase.Label: lunar independence
MaleWolfein_NoMoonPhase.Description: By suppressing the Wolfein's innate lunar sensitivity, this gene eliminates the moon cycle's influence on combat performance. Soldiers with this gene maintain consistent combat effectiveness regardless of lunar phase — no more full-moon frenzy or new-moon weakness.

MaleWolfein_NoNightOwl_KeepNightVision.Label: tactical diurnalism
MaleWolfein_NoNightOwl_KeepNightVision.Description: A military-grade gene designed for frontline Wolfein soldiers. It suppresses daytime drowsiness while preserving the Wolfein's natural night combat superiority — allowing troops to remain alert during daytime patrols without sacrificing their edge in nocturnal operations. The retained night adaptations come at an increased metabolic cost.

MaleWolfein_NoNightOwl_NoNightVision.Label: daylight re-engineering
MaleWolfein_NoNightOwl_NoNightVision.Description: A complete biological overhaul that rewires the Wolfein circadian rhythm for daytime operation. The carrier loses all nocturnal traits — night preference, enhanced night combat performance, and darkness adaptation — in exchange for functioning as a normal daytime worker. Developed by the conglomerate for civilian employees who must keep production lines running during daylight hours.

MaxTemp_LargeIncrease.Label: heat super-tolerant
MaxTemp_LargeIncrease.Description: Carriers of this gene are more comfortable in warm temperatures.

MaxTemp_SmallDecrease.Label: heat weakness
MaxTemp_SmallDecrease.Description: Carriers of this gene are slightly less comfortable in warm temperatures.

MaxTemp_SmallIncrease.Label: heat tolerant
MaxTemp_SmallIncrease.Description: Carriers of this gene are slightly more comfortable in warm temperatures.

MeleeDamage_Strong.Label: strong melee damage
MeleeDamage_Strong.Description: Carriers of this gene do more damage in close-quarters combat. Extra-strong fast-twitch muscle fibers make their strikes accurate and powerful.

MeleeDamage_Weak.Label: weak melee damage
MeleeDamage_Weak.Description: Carriers of this gene do less damage in close-quarters combat. Weak fast-twitch muscle fibers make their strikes shaky and weak.

MinTemp_LargeDecrease.Label: cold super-tolerant
MinTemp_LargeDecrease.Description: Carriers of this gene are much more comfortable in cold temperatures.

MinTemp_SmallDecrease.Label: cold tolerant
MinTemp_SmallDecrease.Description: Carriers of this gene are slightly more comfortable in cold temperatures.

MinTemp_SmallIncrease.Label: cold weakness
MinTemp_SmallIncrease.Description: Carriers of this gene are slightly less comfortable in cold temperatures.

Mood_Depressive.Label: very unhappy
Mood_Depressive.Description: Carriers of this gene are highly predisposed to negative emotion. They'll see the bad in every situation and have a much lower mood than others.

Mood_Optimist.Label: happy
Mood_Optimist.Description: Carriers of this gene are predisposed to optimistic feelings. They'll have higher mood than others.

Mood_Pessimist.Label: unhappy
Mood_Pessimist.Description: Carriers of this gene are predisposed to pessimistic perceptions. They'll tend to interpret things negatively and have lower mood than others.

Mood_Sanguine.Label: very happy
Mood_Sanguine.Description: Carriers of this gene are highly predisposed to optimism and not at all inclined to think negatively. They'll have much higher mood than others.

MoveSpeed_Quick.Label: fast runner
MoveSpeed_Quick.Description: Carriers of this gene move more quickly than normal.

MoveSpeed_Slow.Label: slow runner
MoveSpeed_Slow.Description: Carriers of this gene move more slowly than normal.

MoveSpeed_Space.Label: low gravity adapted
MoveSpeed_Space.Description: Carriers of this gene move and work more easily in low-gravity environments. However, they're slower and less efficient when planetside.

MoveSpeed_VeryQuick.Label: very fast runner
MoveSpeed_VeryQuick.Description: Carriers of this gene move much more quickly than normal.

NakedSpeed.Label: naked speed
NakedSpeed.Description: Carriers of this gene move slower while clothed, and faster while naked.

Nearsighted.Label: nearsighted
Nearsighted.Description: Carriers of this gene have difficulty seeing at a distance. Their shooting accuracy at long ranges is reduced.

Neversleep.Label: never sleep
Neversleep.Description: Carriers of this gene have a unique metabolic process which allows clusters of neurons to sleep while the rest of the brain stays awake. They never need to sleep.

Nose_Human.Label: human nose
Nose_Human.Description: Carriers of this gene have regular human noses.

Nose_Pig.Label: pig nose
Nose_Pig.Description: Carriers of this gene have pig-like snouts.

Pain_Extra.Label: extra pain
Pain_Extra.Description: Carriers of this gene feel more pain than others given the same injuries. Neuron activity in the brain's nociception center is amplified, so pain feels extra-intense and fiery. This can be protective, but overall it's considered a negative and makes it hard to push through difficult situations.

Pain_Reduced.Label: reduced pain
Pain_Reduced.Description: Carriers of this gene feel half as much pain compared to a baseliner. Reduced neuron activity in the brain's nociception centers makes pain dull and faint. This can be advantageous sometimes, and dangerous other times.

PerfectImmunity.Label: perfect immunity
PerfectImmunity.Description: Carriers of this gene have archite-enhanced immune systems which intelligently destroy invaders. They are totally immune to most normal illnesses.

PiercingSpine.Label: piercing spine
PiercingSpine.Description: Carriers grow an opening in their upper chest along with a quiver of keratin spines. Using a hemogen-powered chemical reaction, they can fire these spines at high speed at nearby targets with surprising accuracy.

PollutionRush.Label: pollution stimulus
PollutionRush.Description: Carriers of this gene get a chemical rush from being exposed to pollution. This makes them move faster and helps them think clearer. A similar gene is found in combat-engineered mega-insects.

PsychicAbility_Deaf.Label: psychically deaf
PsychicAbility_Deaf.Description: Carriers of this gene are deaf to all psychic energy and influence outside their own minds. They cannot be affected by psychic influence, nor can they ever wield psychic power.

PsychicAbility_Dull.Label: psychically dull
PsychicAbility_Dull.Description: Carriers of this gene are less psychically-sensitive than others.

PsychicAbility_Enhanced.Label: psy-sensitive
PsychicAbility_Enhanced.Description: Carriers of this gene are more psychically-sensitive than average.

PsychicAbility_Extreme.Label: super psy-sensitive
PsychicAbility_Extreme.Description: Carriers of this gene are much more psychically-sensitive than most.

PsychicBonding.Label: psychic bonding
PsychicBonding.Description: Carriers of this gene have a special neural organ that makes them psychically bond with a lover for life. As long as the lovers are together, they will be happy. If they are physically separated, they will be disturbed by the distance. If one dies, the other's mind will be badly disrupted.

Robust.Label: robust
Robust.Description: Carriers of this gene take less injuries than others from the same damage. They have thickened, densified bones, nearly-solid ribcages, and strengthened binding factors in joints and flesh.

RobustDigestion.Label: robust digestion
RobustDigestion.Description: Carriers of this gene grow a multi-fold stomach, allowing them to digest raw foods more efficiently than baseline humans. In general, they get the same nutrition from raw food as from if it is cooked. They also don't mind the taste of raw food at all.

Skin_Blue.Label: blue skin
Skin_Blue.Description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that turns their skin a blue color.

Skin_DeepRed.Label: deep red skin
Skin_DeepRed.Description: Carriers of this gene produce a deep-red pigment that gives their skin an almost bloody appearance.

Skin_DeepYellow.Label: deep yellow skin
Skin_DeepYellow.Description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a deep yellow color.

Skin_Green.Label: green skin
Skin_Green.Description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a green color.

Skin_InkBlack.Label: ink black skin
Skin_InkBlack.Description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that turns their skin a pale black color almost as dark as ink.

Skin_LightGray.Label: light gray skin
Skin_LightGray.Description: Carriers of this produce a light-gray pigment in their skin.

Skin_Melanin1.Label: skin color
Skin_Melanin1.Description: Carriers of this gene have a particular skin color. With multiple skin color genes, one is randomly selected.

Skin_Melanin2.Label: skin color
Skin_Melanin2.Description: Carriers of this gene have a particular skin color. With multiple skin color genes, one is randomly selected.

Skin_Melanin3.Label: skin color
Skin_Melanin3.Description: Carriers of this gene have a particular skin color. With multiple skin color genes, one is randomly selected.

Skin_Melanin4.Label: skin color
Skin_Melanin4.Description: Carriers of this gene have a particular skin color. With multiple skin color genes, one is randomly selected.

Skin_Melanin5.Label: skin color
Skin_Melanin5.Description: Carriers of this gene have a particular skin color. With multiple skin color genes, one is randomly selected.

Skin_Melanin6.Label: skin color
Skin_Melanin6.Description: Carriers of this gene have a particular skin color. With multiple skin color genes, one is randomly selected.

Skin_Melanin7.Label: skin color
Skin_Melanin7.Description: Carriers of this gene have a particular skin color. With multiple skin color genes, one is randomly selected.

Skin_Melanin8.Label: skin color
Skin_Melanin8.Description: Carriers of this gene have a particular skin color. With multiple skin color genes, one is randomly selected.

Skin_Melanin9.Label: skin color
Skin_Melanin9.Description: Carriers of this gene have a particular skin color. With multiple skin color genes, one is randomly selected.

Skin_Orange.Label: orange skin
Skin_Orange.Description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin an orange color.

Skin_PaleRed.Label: pale red skin
Skin_PaleRed.Description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that turns their skin a moderate red color.

Skin_PaleYellow.Label: pale yellow skin
Skin_PaleYellow.Description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that turns their skin a grayish yellow color.

Skin_Purple.Label: purple skin
Skin_Purple.Description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that gives their skin a purple color.

Skin_SheerWhite.Label: sheer white skin
Skin_SheerWhite.Description: Carriers of this gene have sheer white skin, unlike natural skin tones, due to a special engineered reflective cell covering.

Skin_SlateGray.Label: slate gray skin
Skin_SlateGray.Description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment that turns their skin slate gray.

Sleepy.Label: sleepy
Sleepy.Description: Carriers of this gene get tired somewhat faster than others.

Sterile.Label: sterile
Sterile.Description: Carriers of this gene cannot reproduce by natural means.

StrongStomach.Label: strong stomach
StrongStomach.Description: Carriers of this gene have an extra toxin-filtering organ in their stomach and will never suffer from food poisoning even after eating rotten food.

Superclotting.Label: superclotting
Superclotting.Description: Carriers of this gene have extra-power coagulating factors in their blood, and will stop bleeding very quickly when wounded.

Tail_Furry.Label: furry tail
Tail_Furry.Description: Carriers of this gene grow a fluffy tail which partially protects them from cold temperatures.

Tail_Smooth.Label: smooth tail
Tail_Smooth.Description: Carriers of this gene grow a slender tail that can act as a dexterous fifth limb.

TotalHealing.Label: scarless
TotalHealing.Description: Carriers of this gene have a special type of regenerator cell which can heal old wounds and chronic illnesses like bad back.

ToxicEnvironmentResistance_Partial.Label: partial antitoxic lungs
ToxicEnvironmentResistance_Partial.Description: Carriers of this gene are resistant to environmental toxins. They get less toxic buildup from tox gas, polluted terrain, and toxic fallout, but are still vulnerable to direct attacks with venom or injected poison. Additionally, they build up rot stink exposure slower.

ToxicEnvironmentResistance_Total.Label: total antitoxic lungs
ToxicEnvironmentResistance_Total.Description: Carriers of this gene are immune to environmental toxins, but not from direct toxic attacks. They get no toxic buildup from tox gas, polluted terrain, or toxic fallout, and they are not bothered by acidic smog. They are still vulnerable to direct attacks like venom and injected poison. Additionally, they are immune to rot stink exposure.

ToxResist_Partial.Label: tox resistance
ToxResist_Partial.Description:
Carriers of this gene are resistant to toxic buildup from any source. This includes pollution, toxic fallout, tox gas, and direct attacks with venom or injected poison. They'll gain half the amount of toxic buildup compared to others.

Cellular filters in the lung and skin reduce the dose of toxins entering the bloodstream.

ToxResist_Total.Label: tox immunity
ToxResist_Total.Description:
Carriers of this gene are totally immune to toxic buildup from all sources including polluted terrain, toxic fallout, tox gas, and direct attacks with venom or injected poison. They are also not bothered by acidic smog.

The carrier's biochemical pathways are modified to route around interference from nearly all known toxins. Along with enhancements to the kidneys and liver, this keeps carriers comfortable in even the most toxic of environments.

Unstoppable.Label: unstoppable
Unstoppable.Description: Carriers of this gene are not slowed down when taking damage.

UVSensitivity_Intense.Label: intense UV sensitivity
UVSensitivity_Intense.Description: Carriers of this gene have biological compounds in their skin that react dangerously to UV radiation. They are intensely sensitive to sunlight.

UVSensitivity_Mild.Label: mild UV sensitivity
UVSensitivity_Mild.Description: Carriers of this gene have biological compounds in their skin that react painfully to UV radiation. They are unusually sensitive to sunlight.

VacuumResistance_Partial.Label: vacuum resistant
VacuumResistance_Partial.Description: Carriers of this gene have skin that releases a waxy substance when air pressure is low, preventing vacuum burns and allowing them to survive longer when exposed to vacuum.

VacuumResistance_Total.Label: breathless
VacuumResistance_Total.Description: Carriers of this gene can store concentrated oxygen in their bodies. Their cells consume much less oxygen, meaning they rarely need to breathe. These adaptations make them immune to the harmful effects of space, as well as environmental toxins, tox gas, acidic smog, and rot stink.

VerySleepy.Label: very sleepy
VerySleepy.Description: Carriers of this gene get tired much faster than others.

ViolenceDisabled.Label: violence disabled
ViolenceDisabled.Description: Carriers of this gene are emotionally and mentally incapable of engaging in violence. They are overwhelmingly resistant to and horrified by the idea of hurting another.

Voice_Human.Label: human voice
Voice_Human.Description: Carriers of this gene have regular human vocal cords.

VoicePig.Label: pig voice
VoicePig.Description: Carriers have a squealing voice like that of a pig.

VoiceRoar.Label: roar voice
VoiceRoar.Description: Carriers have an animal-like roaring voice.

VRE_AnimalFeeder.Label: animalfeeder
VRE_AnimalFeeder.Description: Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from fresh warm blood. They can bite any animal, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly. This can sometimes make the animal attack the gene carrier.

VRE_BatEars.Label: bat ears
VRE_BatEars.Description: Carriers of this gene have bat-like ears.

VRE_BatNose.Label: bat nose
VRE_BatNose.Description: Carriers of this gene have bat-like leaf nose.

VRE_CanineEars.Label: canine ears
VRE_CanineEars.Description: Carriers of this gene will grow wolf-like ears.

VRE_CanineNose.Label: canine nose
VRE_CanineNose.Description: Carriers of this gene have wolf-like noses.

VRE_CanineTail.Label: wolf tail
VRE_CanineTail.Description: Carriers of this gene grow a wolf-like tail that helps them with movement slightly.

VRE_ChestFur.Label: chest fur
VRE_ChestFur.Description: Carriers of this gene grow thick fur on their chest.

VRE_CorpseFeeder.Label: corpsefeeder
VRE_CorpseFeeder.Description: Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from cold, rotting blood. They can bite any human corpse, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly.

VRE_DodgeDisabled.Label: dodge disabled
VRE_DodgeDisabled.Description: Carriers of this gene are incapable of dodging attacks. Lack of combat perception results in being hit by every swing - even the one that would miss.

VRE_Ecstasy.Label: ecstasy
VRE_Ecstasy.Description: Carriers of this gene can psychically connect with the target briefly, granting them a sense of ecstasy and making them fall in love with the caster.

VRE_ExtremeHemogenDrain.Label: extreme hemogen drain
VRE_ExtremeHemogenDrain.Description: Carriers lose an additional 12 hemogen per day from biological entropy.

VRE_FilterInfection.Label: filter infection
VRE_FilterInfection.Description: Carriers of this gene have special glands in their mouths that allow them to filter infected blood from the clean blood.

VRE_GermlineReimplanter.Label: germline reimplanter
VRE_GermlineReimplanter.Description: Carriers of this gene can implant a copy of their germline into another person through an injector organ. Their own genetic material will then regrow very slowly. If they implant while their genes are regrowing, they will die. Xenogenes will be unaffected.

VRE_HeartCrush.Label: heart crush
VRE_HeartCrush.Description: Carriers of this gene have special adrenaline glands that allow them to find the beating heart of the opponent and rip it out in a mad fury.

VRE_Hemosmosis.Label: hemosmosis
VRE_Hemosmosis.Description: Carriers of this gene are able to drain blood from their environment, provided there is blood to be drained there.

VRE_ImprovedDodge.Label: improved dodge
VRE_ImprovedDodge.Description: Carriers of this gene can dodge attacks more easily. Extra-capable in perception, they anticipate attacks before they happen.

VRE_IntenseLightSensitivity.Label: intense light sensitivity
VRE_IntenseLightSensitivity.Description: Carriers of this gene have biological compounds in their eyes that react dangerously to light photons. They are intensely sensitive to any light sources.

VRE_LightSensitivity.Label: light sensitivity
VRE_LightSensitivity.Description: Carriers of this gene have biological compounds in their eyes that react painfully to light photons. They are unusually sensitive to any light sources.

VRE_LowHemogenDrain.Label: low hemogen drain
VRE_LowHemogenDrain.Description: Carriers lose an additional 4 hemogen per day from biological entropy.

VRE_Morphs_AdulthoodMorphing.Label: adulthood morphing
VRE_Morphs_AdulthoodMorphing.Description: Carriers of this gene undergo a morphing process when reaching adulthood. It cannot be stopped or prevented. They will never morph back.

VRE_Morphs_DamageMorphing.Label: damage morphing
VRE_Morphs_DamageMorphing.Description: Carriers of this gene undergo a morphing process when badly wounded, and will only morph back when almost fully regenerated.

VRE_Morphs_NocturnalMorphing.Label: nocturnal morphing
VRE_Morphs_NocturnalMorphing.Description: Carriers of this gene undergo a morphing process every night. It cannot be stopped or prevented. They will only morph back come morning.

VRE_Morphs_RandomMorphing.Label: random morphing
VRE_Morphs_RandomMorphing.Description: Carriers of this gene undergo a morphing process seemingly at random. Nobody knows what the morphing condition is, or whether it can be controlled in any way. Morphing will occur in random time intervals.

VRE_Morphs_SeasonalMorphing.Label: seasonal morphing
VRE_Morphs_SeasonalMorphing.Description: Carriers of this gene undergo a morphing process on 1st of Septober, and then morph back on 1st of Aprimay.

VRE_MoveSpeed_ExtremelyQuick.Label: extremely fast runner
VRE_MoveSpeed_ExtremelyQuick.Description: Carriers of this gene have a special type of muscle-stimulating cell that allows them to move at superhuman speeds.

VRE_Nocturnal.Label: nocturnal
VRE_Nocturnal.Description: Carriers of this gene prefer to work at night. They are happier if awake at nights and unhappy if awake during the day.

VRE_OnlySideburns.Label: only sideburns
VRE_OnlySideburns.Description: Male carriers of this gene experience rapid beard growth on the sides of their face.

VRE_PackMentality.Label: pack mentality
VRE_PackMentality.Description: Carriers of this gene are capable of forming tightly knit communities, and become happier the stronger their community is.

VRE_Photophobia.Label: photophobia
VRE_Photophobia.Description: Carriers of this gene have an intense fear of light. When any light source is close, there is a chance they will have a mental breakdown at any moment.

VRE_Resurrect.Label: resurrect
VRE_Resurrect.Description: Carriers have a reserve of unique resurrector archites which can infuse a corpse, rebuild degenerated tissue and kickstart the vital processes. This brings the dead back to life - though possibly with health issues. This can only be done very rarely, and comes at a steep hemogen cost.

VRE_SanguineHair.Label: sanguine haired
VRE_SanguineHair.Description: Carriers of this gene have their hair naturally styled into elder sanguine hairstyles.

VRE_SanguoFeeder.Label: sanguofeeder
VRE_SanguoFeeder.Description: Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from fresh warm blood of other sanguophages. They can bite an unresisting sanguophage, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly.

VRE_Sensitivity_Dangerous.Label: dangerous UV sensitivity
VRE_Sensitivity_Dangerous.Description: Carriers of this gene have biological compounds in their skin that react dangerously to UV radiation. They are extremely sensitive to sunlight.

VRE_SpeechInability.Label: speech inability
VRE_SpeechInability.Description: Carriers of this gene lost the ability to understand and partake in the act of talking.

VRE_SuperiorDarkVision.Label: superior dark vision
VRE_SuperiorDarkVision.Description: Carriers of this gene see much better low light than well lit areas, and are unaffected by mood penalties related to darkness. They have a reflective layer behind the retina that amplifies their ability to see in the dark.

VRE_SuperiorDodge.Label: superior dodge
VRE_SuperiorDodge.Description: Carriers of this gene can dodge attacks very easily. Extra-capable in perception, they anticipate attacks before they happen.

VRE_Talons.Label: talons
VRE_Talons.Description: Carriers of this gene have hands that partially resemble talons. This reduces their ability to manipulate objects, but allows them to perform special attacks in melee combat.

VRE_Territorial.Label: territorial
VRE_Territorial.Description: Carriers of this gene are extremely territorial and will feel more calm in their own land, and at the same time increasingly uneasy as they leave it.

VRE_ToxicCloud.Label: toxic cloud
VRE_ToxicCloud.Description: Carriers of this gene are able to excrete a thick toxic smoke from special organic reservoirs in their lungs. Tox gas is deadly to almost every creature.

VRE_UpperBatEars.Label: chiropteric ears
VRE_UpperBatEars.Description: Carriers of this gene have pointy bat-like ears.

VRE_ViscuousGoo.Label: viscuous goo
VRE_ViscuousGoo.Description: Carriers grow glands in the neck that generate and store a thick goo. They can spit it over long distances and cover several people in a viscous goo that will slow them down.

VRE_WarHowl.Label: warhowl
VRE_WarHowl.Description: Carriers of this gene can perform a wicked warhowl, using a powerful bellow and psychic connection to call on their allies to fight more aggressively.

WebbedPhalanges.Label: webbed phalanges
WebbedPhalanges.Description: Carriers of this gene have webbed fingers and toes, allowing them to move faster in water. Webbed fingers slightly reduce fine motor control.

WoundHealing_Fast.Label: fast wound healing
WoundHealing_Fast.Description: Carriers of this gene heal from wounds twice as fast as normal.

WoundHealing_Slow.Label: slow wound healing
WoundHealing_Slow.Description: Carriers of this gene heal from wounds half as fast as normal.

WoundHealing_SuperFast.Label: superfast wound healing
WoundHealing_SuperFast.Description: Carriers of this gene heal from wounds four times as fast as normal.

XenogermReimplanter.Label: gene implanter
XenogermReimplanter.Description: Carriers of this gene can implant a copy of their xenogerm into another person through a somewhat gross-looking injector organ. Their own genetic material will then regrow very slowly. If they implant while their genes are regrowing, they will die. Germline genes will be unaffected.
